title: Localization Strings sometimes Fail and need to be Inputted again.
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in Godot 4.1 Stable, 4.2 Stable, and 4.3 Stable

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable.mono - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 Threads)

### Issue description

Every once in a while, Godot will "Forget" the proper key for a localization. This will cause a key to fail to be translated to the proper language. Reinputting the key exactly the same as it was fixes the issue.

As an example, here is one of my keys. For testing purposes it is just the full English line.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad1495e8-a594-4219-be7a-83ddfc9d39b5)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6b0c1475-9f0e-4267-9db6-83a428a3bbb5)
In editor, it is exactly the same, however it doesn't properly display in game, showing only the English text no matter what. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61b98259-f3e9-47fd-b344-833b153c4b56)
Testing in Spanish. As you can see, the English text is still shown.

Now, if I go in editor, add a space to the string, and then remove that space (leaving me with the same string as before) the translation now works.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3bc4426b-0a7b-42bf-8a25-7073ba431a01)

This seems to happen to random strings across the game at random intervals, and is a massive pain to fix every time it happens.

This has occurred for me in Godot 4.1 Stable, 4.2 Stable, and 4.3 Stable. I have not gotten the chance to test in 4.4

### Steps to reproduce

This is a tough one to reproduce easily, since it seems to occur at random times.

-Create string with localization csv created in Google Sheets
-A long string key may work to break it faster
-Reload and Close other game scenes until localization eventually breaks

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

 Any project with a Text String and translation csv will work.
